title_as_printed: Mild cognitive impairment and abnormal brain metabolic expression in idiopathic REM sleep behavior disorder

blind_codes.Sample_N: 44 iRBD (20 iRBD-MCI + 24 iRBD-NC); 57 with the 13 healthy controls

registry_codes.Sample_N_Approx: 57 - 44 iRBD patients (24 iRBD-NC / 20 iRBD-MCI) plus 13 healthy controls. The canonical study cohort is the 44 prospectively followed iRBD patients; the 13 controls are a comparison group that the paper describes as carried over from the authors' earlier work

Task_Type.reason: The study compares FDG-PET pattern expression across controls, iRBD-NC and iRBD-MCI (Kruskal-Wallis, Mann-Whitney), runs correlations, and uses Kaplan-Meier/log-rank with a hazard ratio for cognitive deterioration. No discrimination figure is reported.

Category.reason: The registry's C1 captures the FDG-PET metabolic-network domain. The paper's first aim is a C5 domain the code omits: MCI prevalence, cognitive domain profiles and two-yearly neuropsychological decline from the Seoul Neuropsychological Screening Battery (Tables 1-2). Readings: C1 (the distinctive analysis) or C1;C5.
Category.quote: Forty-four patients with polysomnography-confirmed iRBD performed a standardized battery of neuropsychological examinations every two years.

Validation_Type.reason: No predictive model is validated; the spatial covariance patterns were derived and validated in the authors' earlier study. Convention: V2.

Sample_N_Approx.reason: The 44 iRBD patients (24 NC + 20 MCI) and 13 healthy controls are all analysed in Table 1 and Fig. 2A, and the 2SD cut-off comes from the controls, so 57 is the analysed N. 44 is the iRBD cohort N. The paper supports both, and the registry states which it uses.
Sample_N_Approx.quote: Control (A, n = 13) iRBD-NC (B, n = 24) iRBD-MCI (C, n = 20)

Publication_Year.reason: Parkinsonism and Related Disorders 90 (2021); available online 22 July 2021.

ADNI_Dependent.reason: Single-centre Korean iRBD cohort; ADNI is not used.
